title: While We’re Here
subtitle: Small essays about attention, technology, beauty, time, and being alive
author: Adam Hickey
backCoverLine: Some things become ordinary only because we have stopped looking at them.
backCoverBlurb: Eighteen short essays on paying attention — to weather, to strangers, to machines that are learning to think, to the people who will not always be here. A book for reading straight through, or for opening at random on a Tuesday.
